name: astrohealth-ai
description: AstroHealth AI — online-capable astronaut health monitoring prototype with optional offline support (NASA Space Apps student project). Dev-time tooling only; the app itself runs without Node.

scripts.setup: node scripts/copy-vendor.mjs && node scripts/build-icons.mjs && node scripts/build-brand.mjs && node scripts/build-sw-manifest.mjs
